correctness.rationale: The lateral cylinder is exactly the flat periodic strip. Its wrapped angular gap is Uniform[0,a] and independent of the triangular axial gap. Their squared sum equals squared intrinsic distance for every endpoint pair; direct splitting of an elementary conditional integral proves the entire CDF and PDF. Explicit local integrals give the nonzero 3/2 and 5/2 singularities; corner scaling gives the cubic tail. Binomial integration gives moments and linear algebra gives unique inverse recovery. The included verifier independently tests, but is not used to establish, the continuum identities.

value.rationale: Complete classification of a natural metric-measure distribution for every finite circular cylindrical lateral surface, with sharp and geometrically distinct 3/2 angular-cut-locus and 5/2 axial-boundary onset exponents, a cubic farthest-point tail, all even moments, and exact recovery of radius and height from the distribution.
